children: Victory Capital reported Total Client Assets of $360.2 billion and Total AUM of $356.5 billion as of August 31, 2026.
Total Assets Under Management were $356.5 billion as of August 31, 2026, up from $345.1 billion on July 31, 2026.
Total Client Assets totaled $360.2 billion, including Other Assets of $3.7 billion (vs. $348.8B total client assets on July 31).
Average August AUM was $353.2 billion and average Total Client Assets were $356.9 billion for the month.
By asset class, Total Long-Term Assets were $352.8 billion; notable categories include Solutions $114.1B and Fixed Income $88.1B.
By vehicle, Mutual Funds held $182.0 billion, Separate Accounts and pooled vehicles $151.0 billion, and ETFs $23.5 billion.
